privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This system records lab attendance for members of robotics team 1156 Under Control (FRC and FTC). It is used only internally by the team.
privacy.collect1: From your Google account: name, email and account identifier, used only to sign you in.
privacy.collect2: From your profile: name, category (FRC or FTC), type (student or mentor), entrance code and preferred language.
privacy.collect3: From attendance: check-in and check-out times recorded at the lab computer, and correction requests.
privacy.use: To compute attendance hours and percentages against the season goals and to organize the team. We don't sell it, share it with third parties, or use it for advertising.
privacy.access: Each member sees only their own data. Team mentors and administrators see everyone's data to follow attendance. The lab computer shows only the names of people currently present.
privacy.storage: Data is stored in Supabase (database, São Paulo region) and the website is hosted on Vercel. Sign-in is provided by Google.
privacy.rights: You can view and correct your name, code and language on the My attendance page. To have your account and data deleted, contact a team mentor or administrator.
